name: onslaught-career-editor-workspace
description: Onslaught preservation workspace: retail RE, Godot rebuild, and Godot toolkit companion.

scripts.test: npm run test:save-lab && npm run test:godot-host
scripts.test:ui-runtime: npm run require:windows-host && dotnet build ./OnslaughtCareerEditor.WinUI/OnslaughtCareerEditor.WinUI.csproj --nologo && dotnet test ./OnslaughtCareerEditor.UiTests/OnslaughtCareerEditor.UiTests.csproj --nologo --filter "TestCategory=WinUIRuntime"
scripts.test:ui: npm run require:windows-host && dotnet build ./OnslaughtCareerEditor.WinUI/OnslaughtCareerEditor.WinUI.csproj --nologo && dotnet test ./OnslaughtCareerEditor.UiTests/OnslaughtCareerEditor.UiTests.csproj --nologo
scripts.test:safe-copy: npm run require:windows-host && dotnet test ./OnslaughtCareerEditor.AppCore.Tests/OnslaughtCareerEditor.AppCore.Tests.csproj --nologo --filter "FullyQualifiedName~GameProfile|FullyQualifiedName~BinaryPatchCatalogContractTests|FullyQualifiedName~SafeCopyProfileCatalogContractTests" && dotnet test ./OnslaughtCareerEditor.UiTests/OnslaughtCareerEditor.UiTests.csproj --nologo --filter "FullyQualifiedName~BinaryPatchRegressionTests"
scripts.test:cli: npm run require:windows-host && dotnet test ./OnslaughtCareerEditor.Cli.Tests/OnslaughtCareerEditor.Cli.Tests.csproj --nologo && dotnet run --project ./OnslaughtCareerEditor.Cli/OnslaughtCareerEditor.Cli.csproj -- --help
scripts.test:docs: python tools/md_link_check.py --check-only && npm run test:doc-headers && npm run test:re-function-doc-names && python tools/re_evidence_register_export.py --state developer_state.json --check-header-only && python tools/doc_current_authority_check.py --self-test && python tools/doc_current_authority_check.py
scripts.test:notices: npm run require:windows-host && dotnet restore ./OnslaughtCareerEditor.WinUI.slnx --nologo && python ./tools/generate_winui_third_party_notices.py --check
scripts.release:winui-zip: npm run require:windows-host && python ./tools/winui_lore_pack_builder.py --self-test && python ./tools/winui_zip_package_probe_test.py && python ./tools/winui_zip_package_probe.py --check --include-media-smoke
scripts.test:rebuild: npm run require:windows-host && npm run test:rebuild-core && npm run test:rebuild-ferry-sweep && npm run test:rebuild-client && python ./rebuild/tools/cmsh_static_preview_tests.py && pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File ./rebuild/tools/GodotToolchain.Tests.ps1 && pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File ./rebuild/tools/Capture-Session.Tests.ps1

./OnslaughtCareerEditor.AppCore.Tests/OnslaughtCareerEditor.AppCore.Tests.csproj --nologo --no-build --no-restore --filter
